For Bengaluru–Chennai, I’d shortlist:

Provider	Typical one-way cost*	Why shortlist	Cancellation/return
redBus	₹310–₹6,000+	300+ daily buses, widest comparison	Operator-specific; service fees may be non-refundable 
redBus
+1

KSRTC	Check current fare	Government operator; reliable option	10% fee >72h, 25% at 24–72h, 50% at 2–24h; no refund <2h 
KSRTC

AbhiBus	Operator-dependent	Good aggregator + cancellation options	Operator charges + ₹15 AbhiBus fee; convenience fees generally non-refundable 
AbhiBus

*Fares vary significantly by date, bus type and demand. Current listings show roughly 6h 57m average journey time. 
redBus

Before paying, compare: final checkout price (including fees), boarding/drop location, sleeper vs seater, AC, cancellation cutoff, refund amount, and whether discounts affect the refundable amount.
